review_type: Five final family PNGs opened via view_image, all15 variants inspected visually. No audio perception available; no listening claim.

observations.CoachPop: Compact low/mid-heavy wood onset, paper component visible, decaying tail and faded endpoints; three distinct shapes. Gentleness and non-cartoon character need audition.
observations.RefitFanfare: Two distinct bell attack columns at0 and about0.4s; lower sustained horn band starts around1.1s and fades under bell tail. Same source strike reused; bell/horn scale and cropped horn release need audition.
observations.TabTap: Small low-frequency contacts at a lower measured level/peak than all existing Click variants. All three shorter than0.1s. Apparent quietness and repeated-tab comfort need audition.
observations.CoinBuy: Two separated groups of metal transients, with a brief inter-event gap and second drop/rattle; all below0.5s. Variants0/2 approach the allowed peak ceiling but remain below-3dBTP; ear comparison with Coins remains pending.
observations.PageTurn: Three different broadband paper movements with event lengths0.42–0.55s, no flat digital clipping; first is more impulsive, third quieter in peak. Actual unfold/chart timbre and source background need audition.
